Method of Attack: Exploiting unpatched Pulse Secure VPN servers to gain remote unauthenticated access
Compromise vulnerable VPN servers to gain access to active users and plain-text credentials
Executing arbitrary commands on VPN servers
Remotely viewing logs and cached passwords in plain text
Propagating ransomware through interactive prompts of the VPN interface

Attack Vector: Remote code execution vulnerability CVE-2019-11510 in Pulse Secure VPN
Unpatched VPN servers accessible over the internet
Exploit code available via Metasploit framework and GitHub
